name: Competitor profile from public pages
summary: Your marketing lead gets a dated profile of a named competitor, built only from its public pages: what they say, sell and charge, kept apart from what that suggests and the questions it raises for you. Any figure no page states is marked unavailable, never estimated.

sources.title: Its own competitor profiling guide, used in its marketing work.

sources.contribution: The method this capability rewrites: profile each competitor in one fixed shape, keep what was observed apart from what is inferred, and mark a figure unavailable when no source states it.
